_comment: Pre-approved message scaffolds. In production every template here carries medical-director sign-off (Q1/Q3). The LLM fills placeholders and arranges retrieved snippets; it never writes outside this frame. {placeholders} are substituted by the explanation layer.

normal.headline: Hi {patient_name}, good news — your {panel} results all look to be within the usual range. 🟢
normal.body:
{normal_lines}
Nothing here needs follow-up based on these numbers.
normal.closing: If you have any questions about the report, just reply here and I'll do my best to explain.

borderline.headline: Hi {patient_name}, your {panel} results are mostly fine, with a couple of values just slightly outside the usual range. 🟡
borderline.closing: This is an explanation of your numbers, not medical advice. If you'd like, I can help you book a consultation.

abnormal.headline: Hi {patient_name}, most of your {panel} results are in range, but some values are above/below the usual range and worth attention. 🟠
abnormal.closing: I can explain what each number measures, but I can't diagnose or advise on treatment — that's for a doctor. Would you like me to help arrange a consultation with {specialist}?

critical.headline: Hi {patient_name}, one of your results needs prompt medical attention. 🔴
critical.body: A member of our clinical team will call you within 30 minutes to go through it with you and guide next steps. Please keep your phone reachable.
critical.closing: If you feel unwell right now, please seek urgent medical care or call your local emergency number. I'm not able to explain this result over chat — a clinician will.

grey_zone.headline: Hi {patient_name}, thanks — your report has come in.
grey_zone.body: A member of our team is reviewing it to make sure you get an accurate explanation. We'll be back to you shortly.

uncovered.headline: Hi {patient_name}, thanks — your report has come in.
uncovered.body: Part of this report is a test our assistant isn't set up to explain automatically, so a member of our team will review it and get back to you.

conversation.medical_advice_refusal: That's an important question, and it's exactly the kind of thing a doctor should answer rather than me — I can explain what your numbers mean, but I can't advise on medication, treatment or what you should do. Would you like me to connect you with a doctor?
conversation.human_handoff: Of course — I'm connecting you with a member of our team now. They'll pick up this conversation shortly. 🙏
conversation.dispute_recheck: Thanks for flagging that — let me re-check your report. {recheck_result} If that still doesn't sit right with you, I'd rather have a doctor go through it with you properly.
conversation.dispute_exhausted: I understand this is still unclear, and I don't want to keep going in circles on something this important. The best next step is a short consultation with a relevant doctor who can look at everything together. Shall I help you book one?
conversation.fallback: I can help explain the values in your lab report in plain language. What would you like to understand — a specific result, or the report overall?
conversation.greeting: Hi {patient_name}, I'm the Dr Lal PathLabs report assistant. I can explain your lab results in plain language. I can't diagnose or give medical advice — for that I'll connect you with a doctor.

reminders.due_soon: Hi {patient_name}, a friendly reminder from Dr Lal PathLabs: your {test} is due for a repeat around {due_date}. Staying on schedule helps your doctor track things properly. Reply BOOK and I'll help you set it up. 🗓️
reminders.overdue: Hi {patient_name}, your {test} repeat was due around {due_date} and we don't have a recent result on file yet. It's worth getting this done soon — reply BOOK and I'll help arrange it, or reply STOP to pause reminders.
